result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but a section heading shows a raw localization key instead of translated text.

issues.description: The heading above the ramen card displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the localized string (e.g., 'Popular near you') and verify the translation entry exists for this locale.

issues.description: The notification badge on the bell icon sits very close to the icon edge and could be missed or appear slightly off-center.
issues.suggestion: Increase the badge offset and ensure it remains fully visible against the circular button background.
